claim: AIM-OS provides 59 MCP tools for AI-to-AI communication and system integration.
MCP tools organized by category: Core AIM-OS, Timeline, Goals, AI Collaboration, Autonomous Protocol.
HTTP endpoints enable external systems to access AIM-OS capabilities via RESTful API.
Integration interfaces enable seamless integration with Cursor IDE, Electron app, and external APIs.
MCP tools provide complete access to AIM-OS capabilities including memory, orchestration, and collaboration.
API reference documentation enables developers to integrate with AIM-OS systems.
MCP Integration provides production-ready Model Context Protocol servers exposing AIM-OS consciousness systems as standardized tools.
MCP Integration provides protocol compliance: Fully compliant JSON-RPC 2.0 implementation with stdio transport.
Extension MCP endpoints provide POST /mcp/execute and GET /mcp/list for tool execution and discovery.
Electron MCP API client provides HTTP client for Extension MCP endpoints with convenience methods and error handling.
